verdict.rationale: Finix documents a monetizing-payments guide for platforms, configurable fee schemas, and fee customizations such as fees per payment method and volume discounts. This supports taking a markup on transactions. Fee reporting is mentioned only generically among its report types. missing for 10: explicit per-seller pricing configuration, documented application-fee/markup mechanics per transaction, reporting that separates platform payments revenue from processing costs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: Finix allows you to easily monetize your payments. We offer out of the box customizability, efficiency, and revenue growth tools.
Some of the fee customizations available are: International charges, Transaction volume discounts, Applying fees per payment method, Accelerate settlement timeframes
Test card payments, configure fees schemas, set payout schedules, and more.
From transactions to disputes and fees, more than 10 report types are automated and available in your personal dashboard
